$comment: Enforced by `npm run budget`, and by CI on every push. Raising a ceiling is a deliberate decision, not a formality — say why in the commit message.

firstLoadGzipKB.$comment: Code needed before the first frame. Phaser 3.90 is ~332 kB gzipped on its own and that is the floor; the headroom above it is the game's.

runtimeAssetsKB.$comment: Images and audio, raw bytes — already compressed formats, so gzip is not meaningful. These load after first paint, so they cost loading-screen time rather than time-to-first-frame. This is the Art & Audio ceiling.

firstLoad.$comment: Derived from the transfer ceiling. 'Slow 4G' is Lighthouse's 1.6 Mbit/s profile; the effective payload rate is ~175 kB/s. Transfer only — real time-to-interactive also includes RTT and JS parse.

runtime.$comment: Not machine-checkable in CI. Verified in the on-device test pass and recorded in docs/device-test-log.md.
